sideFindings: Step-change dialog: when going back with the stepper from Categories after adding a category (not via footer Back), the app opens a dialog titled "Exit setup?" (wizard.discardModal.title) with wizard.discardModal.stepChangesDescription ("... Exiting the process now will result in the loss of all progress made during this session.") and "Exit and Discard" (wizard.common.exitAndDiscard). Clicking Exit and Discard neither exits nor discards: it moves to the clicked step and keeps the change (Cycling kept, its prompts generated). Labels and behaviour disagree. The story says this message stays for back navigation with unsaved changes, so it is in scope only as wording; same as earlier runs.
The same back navigation through the footer Back button never shows this dialog (category added or deleted, prompt unticked), so footer Back and stepper back behave differently.

Review -> stepper Categories showed no dialog in this run (no pending change); earlier runs reported a dialog on that path, probably because they had a pending category change. Trigger = pending category change, not the Review step.
The exit body wizard.discardModal.body "... including the prompts you kept." is shown on Analysis Type and Brand & Country too, before any prompt exists (minor wording).

Not verified: Back to Dashboard disabled during category discovery (discovery returned at once, cached for Decathlon GB) and during creation (no creation allowed); hidden on "Analysis created" not checked.
Console: only brandfetch logo 410 errors (cdn.brandfetch.io lettermark icons), not related.
csvProposals: TC-GEO-1238-003 step 3: "And the user opens the wizard again, selects Brand analysis, clicks Continue, then clicks Back on Brand & Country and Back on Analysis Type" / expected "Back on Brand & Country shows Analysis Type with no confirmation; Back on Analysis Type shows the GEO dashboard with no confirmation" (flag ON, same logic as the TC-004 adaptation). Description: "Back on the first step" instead of "Back on Brand & Country".
TC-GEO-1238-001 test data: "market United Kingdom - English (EN)" (picker label) instead of "GB (EN)" which is the Prompts table chip.

TC-GEO-1238-002 step 2 expected: the body sentence is the same on every step ("including the prompts you kept"); write "\"Exit setup?\" opens with \"Exiting now discards every choice made during this session, including the prompts you kept.\"" so the step is checked on text, not on a step-specific message.

Optional new TC (or note in TC-002): stepper back from Categories with a pending category change opens the short "Exit setup?" (stepChangesDescription); expected behaviour of its "Exit and Discard" to be confirmed with the PO before writing an assertion.
